decisions.reasoning: The top-performing formulations include arginine, trehalose, and poloxamer188. The presence of EDTA seems to have a positive impact when combined with these excipients. Polysorbate80 has shown synergistic effects with arginine in the literature, which is not reflected in the current top-5 but could be explored further. Methionine and sorbitol do not appear beneficial for this specific formulation challenge.

The top-performing formulations all include arginine, trehalose, and either polysorbate80 or poloxamer188. EDTA is present in some but not the best formulation, suggesting it has a minor role. The highest stability scores are achieved with arginine around 14-15 mM, trehalose between 65-79 mM, and polysorbate80 at 0.5-0.7%. We will explore this region further while also testing the impact of EDTA.

The top formulations consistently use arginine, trehalose, and polysorbate80. EDTA is present in some but not all of the top formulations, suggesting it has a moderate benefit. The best scores are achieved with lower concentrations of arginine (11-15 mM) and higher concentrations of trehalose (65-82 mM). Polysorbate80 at 0.2-0.7% also appears to be beneficial. Given these observations, the proposed formulations will focus on optimizing within this range while exploring slight variations in arginine and trehalose concentrations, as well as testing both with and without EDTA.

The best scores are achieved with lower concentrations of surfactant (0.2-0.7%). We will explore variations around these parameters to potentially improve stability.

The top formulations consistently use arginine, a sugar (trehalose or sucrose), and polysorbate80. EDTA is not used in the top three formulations, suggesting it may have a minimal benefit for this specific protein. The highest scores are achieved with moderate concentrations of arginine and sugars, and low to moderate surfactant levels.

EDTA is present in the best formulation but not consistently across the top five, suggesting it has a positive but less critical role. Methionine and mannitol are less effective for this specific degradation pathway.

The best formulation uses sorbitol at a lower concentration compared to sucrose and trehalose. We will explore variations around these top performers, slightly adjusting arginine concentrations, testing different sugars, and including EDTA.
